<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the given product molecule, corresponds to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (breaks a halide bond and forms a carbonyl group). Searching the template catalog with these criteria should return suitable templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2Cl)c1","functional_groups_broken":["halide"],"functional_groups_formed":["carbonyl"],"limit":10}</action_input>
